name: NEOWIZ HOLDINGS Corporation
summary: NEOWIZ HOLDINGS Corporation specializes in the video game sector, offering a wide array of titles compatible with personal computers, mobile devices, and dedicated gaming consoles. This entity, which was established in 1997 and has its main offices in Seongnam-si, South Korea, formally transitioned from its previous name, Neowiz Corporation, to NEOWIZ HOLDINGS Corporation in March 2013.
